ai.headline: Microsoft switches US arbitration provider from AAA to JAMS
ai.summary: Microsoft's Terms of Use now send most US disputes to JAMS instead of the American Arbitration Association, with JAMS rules applying to arbitration; the basic arbitration and class action waiver remains. The Terms also now apply to any other Microsoft consumer products and services that reference them, and Cortana is no longer supported as of 2024.
